newsitem.title: MEXICO: Emvasa to propose increasing capital.
newsitem.headline: Emvasa to propose increasing capital.

text.p: Mexican bottling firm Embotelladores del Valle de Anahuac SA (Emvasa) will propose to its shareholders during a meeting on Friday a capital increase through the issue of new shares.

"There is an offer to increase share capital, through which the Rello family, the principal shareholders, exercises subscription rights worth approximately $7.8 million," Eduardo Macias, Emvasa's financial director, told Reuters.
The money will be used to help pay off some $25 million in debt. The rest of the money will come from the sale of sugar mills and from cash flow from its Empacasa bottling unit, Macias said.
